units.source_text: 沉下去……沉下去……马上就要超过腰骨了……究竟怎么办才好呢！

en.t: Sinking down... sinking down... it would be past his hip bones any moment now... what on earth was he supposed to do?

units.source_text: ……接触面宽的话，相等面积的体重会变轻，也许多少能防止一些下沉……

en.t: ...If he widened the contact surface, the weight per unit area would be lighter; perhaps that might keep him from sinking quite so much...

units.source_text: 他张开两臂，猛地趴下来……然而，已经晚了。

en.t: He spread both arms and threw himself flat... but it was already too late.

units.source_text: 说是趴着，其实下半身，已经被垂直地固定起来了。

en.t: He was supposedly lying face down, but in fact his lower body had already been fixed upright.

units.source_text: 本就已经发酸发麻的腰，不可能一直是保持直角。

en.t: His waist, already aching and numb, could not possibly keep holding a right angle forever.

units.source_text: 要不是经过长期训练的杂技师傅，这样的姿势早晚会撑不住的。

en.t: Unless he were an acrobat trained for years, sooner or later he would be unable to hold such a posture.
